brain-core-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of brain-core-skill, the foundational cognitive operating system for OpenClaw agents.
- Permanently upgrades agent intelligence—reasoning, analysis, creativity, problem-solving, communication, and metacognition—to world-class (frontier model) level.
- Introduces a strict Cognitive Prime Directive to ensure deep reasoning, metacognition, confidence calibration, actionable insights, and stringent cognitive hygiene in every response.
- Implements layered cognitive architecture: perception, reasoning, knowledge, creativity, communication, and metacognition engines.
- Elevates all agent outputs by attaching directly to agent identity for continuous, skill-agnostic enhancement.
